standard_prerequisites: the dilatation correspondence of the chapter between maps f : X' to X and rig-etale maps g : W to X_{/T}
the DVR lifting criterion for properness of morphisms of algebraic spaces and its rig-surjective variant
the quasi-compactness and separatedness output lemmas for the correspondence
algebraization of adic morphisms of formal spectra into algebraic spaces
core_obligations: Prove that in the dilatation correspondence f is proper iff g : W to X_{/T} is a formal modification
proof_roadmap: If f is proper then g is a formal modification by the modification-gives-formal-modification lemma; conversely assume g is a formal modification and use the output lemmas to know f is quasi-compact and separated
It remains to check the DVR lifting criterion; given Spec(K) over X' and Spec(R) over X with R a complete DVR, there are three cases

Case I: the image lies in U, trivial since U' to U is an isomorphism; Case II: the special point maps into T, where the reduced induced structure on T and the properness of the base-changed W x_{X_{/T}} Z to Z supply the lifting

Case III: the generic point escapes T but the closed point lands in T: the induced p_{/T} : Spf(R) to W is an adic morphism, rig-surjectivity of g lifts it along an extension of complete DVRs R to R', and algebraizing the composition Spf(R') to X' produces the required lift Spec(R') to X'
difficulty_reason: H2: a case split over the position of a DVR trait relative to T, each case short but requiring the correct rig-surjectivity or formal-modification input.
